query:
SELECT month AS period, category AS segment, 100.0 * SUM(unit_price * unit_discount * qty) / NULLIF(SUM(unit_price * qty), 0) AS value
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
summary: Nothing unusual for avg_discount_pct by category in period 2025-Q2 (threshold 2.5).. No sales at all for: Bikes 2025-06, Components 2025-05, Components 2025-06
note: This shows WHERE and WHEN. Use run_sql to find out WHY before giving a reason.
